design_strategy.theme_type: Hybrid Dark Hero / Warm Light Content
design_strategy.emotional_archetype: Organic Trust & Professional Care with Caribbean warmth
design_strategy.hero_style: Dark Ocean Navy (#0B132B) with Gold metallic highlights (#D4AF37), Blush Pink accents (#E89D93), glassmorphism cards, and subtle tropical palm silhouette textures.
design_strategy.content_style: Light Warm Cream (#FAF7F2) background with crisp white cards, rich Navy (#0F172A) headings, delicate Blush Pink subtle borders, and Gold rating indicators.
design_strategy.caribbean_identity: Every provider, article, event, and service is tagged by island (e.g. Barbados, Jamaica, Trinidad & Tobago, Saint Lucia, Bahamas, Cayman Islands, Grenada, Antigua & Barbuda) with a prominent global Island Filter Bar.

typography.hero_heading: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-white

header.style: Sticky header with Dark Navy background (bg-[#0B132B]/95 backdrop-blur-md) and subtle gold border bottom (border-b border-[#D4AF37]/30)
elements: Brand Logo (Gold & Pink Cross with wordmark My HealthcareLink)
Navigation Links (Directory, Services, Health Blog, Events, Reviews)

hero.style: Deep Dark Navy gradient container with subtle palm watermarks, glassmorphism hero card, live stats counter (e.g. 1,200+ Verified Caribbean Providers, 12 Islands Covered), and quick multi-criteria search bar (Keyword, Category, Island, Specialty).

island_filter_bar.style: Sticky sub-header or high-visibility pill carousel featuring all Caribbean territories with active state highlighted in Gold (#D4AF37) with Blush Pink badges.

sections_hierarchy: A. Hero with Search & Island Filter Bar
B. Category Quick-Links Grid (Specialties, Clinics, Wellness, Diagnostics, Telehealth)
C. Featured Healthcare Providers Carousel / Bento Grid with Ratings & Island Badges
D. Health Information & Articles Section with Island Tagging
E. Upcoming Healthcare Events & Workshops Carousel
F. Community Reviews & Testimonials Carousel (Admin Approved)
G. Horizon Health Caribbean Expansion Banner
H. Footer with Navy Background, Gold Branding, Island Directory links, and Newsletter Signup

provider_card.design: Clean white card with soft pink/gold border on hover, doctor photo, verified checkmark, island badge, specialty tag, star rating, in-network pill badge, direct contact buttons, and 'Book Appointment' modal trigger.

admin_dashboard.access: Accessible via header toggle with secure passcode or tab switch
tabs: Providers Management (Add / Edit / Deactivate / In-Network Status)
Review Moderation System (Approve / Reject visitor submitted reviews)

reviews_modal.design: Public review submission form for providers with star rating input, verified patient toggle, island selector, and confirmation banner indicating admin review approval step.

testing_requirements.data_testid_policy: All interactive elements, forms, input filters, provider cards, modal buttons, admin table action buttons, and review submission triggers MUST feature clear role-based kebab-case data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow the exact hybrid aesthetic: Dark Navy hero with Gold and Blush Pink highlights, followed by Warm Cream content sections with crisp white cards.
Ensure every provider, article, event, and service includes an assigned island tag and respects the active Island Filter state.
Do not use transparent dropdown backgrounds. Use solid or blurred high-contrast surfaces for all menus and modals.
Implement full CRUD logic for Admin Dashboard (Providers, Services, Categories, Blog Articles, Events, and Review Moderation).
All interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes.
